hud.title: Combat tracker
hud.blocked: This trainer needs an active Pokémon
hud.emptyCombat: Add combatants to the combat to see them here
hud.rollHint: Click: roll initiative · Alt: advantage · Ctrl: disadvantage

error.noActivePokemon: That trainer has no active Pokémon: summon one before rolling initiative.

enabled.name: Enable combat HUD
enabled.hint: Master switch for the top combat bar and the initiative rule.

autoShow.name: Show automatically
autoShow.hint: Open the combat HUD whenever a combat exists.

hideNativeTracker.name: Hide Foundry's combat tracker
hideNativeTracker.hint: Remove the native Combat tab from the sidebar. You can flip it temporarily from the HUD.

gmBypass.name: GMs bypass the initiative rule
gmBypass.hint: Let the GM roll initiative for a trainer without an active Pokémon.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Print extra diagnostics to the browser console.

toggle.name: Toggle combat HUD
toggle.hint: Show or hide the Pokémon-style combat bar.
